links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of chatbot dental trauma management recommendations against IADT guidelines
links.effect: 100% accuracy in recommending appropriate management; initial completeness as low as 53% for primary tooth fractures, improved to 100% in most cases after code adjustments; avulsed open-apex reimplantation reached 93%.
links.quote: The chatbot achieved 100% accuracy in recommending appropriate clinical management.

unlisted_practices: Rule-based system constraining LLM output to clinical guideline protocols
Iterative code adjustment after completeness testing

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and completeness of a newly developed LLM-based chatbot (Dental Trauma Evo) against clinical guidelines across 384 simulated interactions.
